project: SP-007 / DOC-2-033: Causal Graphs From Perturbation Shadows
round: R0 - deep open-data feasibility and grounding
operational_user: perturbation-biology or drug-discovery scientist deciding which directed gene relationships deserve follow-up experiments
output_contract: evidence-ranked hypotheses; never proof of causality, never treatment advice; an inferred edge is never called causal merely because a graph method emitted it

feasibility_gates.G1_primary_source_support: PASS iff >=1 primary single-cell CRISPR perturbation dataset with ALL of: (a) openly redistributable license verified from the archive (CC-BY/CC0/public-domain equivalent); (b) versioned persistent archive (Figshare/Zenodo/GEO) with provider checksums; (c) count matrix + per-cell perturbation assignments + non-targeting control cells; (d) scale floor: >=20 distinct perturbation targets and >=10,000 cells; (e) full download verified by checksum, or selective download verified against provider metadata
feasibility_gates.G2_replication_source: PASS iff a second independent dataset (different lab, platform, or modality) covering >=30% of primary perturbation targets is reachable with license + checksums; FAIL does not stop the round - it forces the semi-synthetic calibration arm and is recorded
feasibility_gates.G3_reference_graph: PASS iff >=1 openly licensed directed gene-interaction reference (e.g. OmniPath, CollecTRI/DoRothEA, SIGNOR, Reactome) retrievable in versioned form, with provenance and incompleteness documented; a semi-synthetic calibration arm spec is frozen regardless and kept clearly separated from biological claims
feasibility_gates.G4_environment: PASS iff every analysis tool is installed with pinned version + sha256 recorded in the environment ledger; missing tools block the benchmark, not the feasibility report

r0_verdict_rule: GO to R1 locked benchmark iff G1 AND G3 AND G4 pass (G2 decides the replication arm, not GO/STOP). Otherwise STOP honestly at feasibility with the audit preserved.

benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.causal_unit: perturbation target (gene-level intervention), cells as replicates; never random-cell splits
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.intervention_exposure: CRISPRi/a/KO guide assignment; guide-efficiency and multiplicity-of-infection sensitivity mandatory
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.response: single-cell gene-expression change vs non-targeting controls, standardized within timepoint x cell-line strata
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.controls: non-targeting controls mandatory; doublet/multiplet policy declared before analysis
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.split: train/test by held-out perturbation target or by study; random-cell split forbidden
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.reference: open directed reference graph with documented provenance and incompleteness; semi-synthetic calibration arm clearly separated
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.baselines: simple association (correlation), perturbation-response mean shift, plus >=1 mature causal/graph method
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.metrics: directionality recovery vs reference, calibration / top-k precision, intervention prediction on held-out targets, uncertainty and abstention rates
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.hard_gates_r1: source support, held-perturbation transport, improvement over correlation, edge-direction recovery, negative controls clean, cross-study replication (if G2 passed), full reproducibility
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.failure_controls_r1: shuffled perturbation labels, permuted time/condition, non-targeting controls, expression-matched null genes, guide-efficiency/MOI sensitivity, cell-state confounding stress, data-leakage assertions; contradictions between association and perturbation evidence preserved
benchmark_design_skeleton_frozen_for_r1.commercial_depth_r1plus: per-edge evidence cards (perturbation, response, study, uncertainty, contradictions), workflow integration, privacy/licensing, monitoring, rollback, compute/runtime, measured reviewer effort

stop_condition: if open datasets lack usable perturbation assignments or any replication path, stop at feasibility and preserve the audit
